name: cofounder
description: Run your company from your AI assistant: shared knowledge, customers, email, social publishing, research, and app launches.

interface.shortDescription: Your company, connected to your AI assistant
interface.longDescription: Bring your company into the AI assistant you already use. Cofounder keeps your plans, documents, customer records, and progress together across conversations. Research opportunities, manage customers, draft and send email, publish social posts, and build and launch your app. Start a new company or pick up an existing one, then work through its roadmap with your assistant. Sign in to connect; the resources and services you choose may have their own costs.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Cofounder.
Show my company's next milestone and help me move it forward.
Review our customer conversations and draft the next follow-ups.
